fusions.name: Herd's Courage
fusions.desc: Fires an arrow that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets. Its damage rises 6% for each ally within 5.5 tiles (max 24%).

fusions.name: Bellwether Arrow
fusions.desc: Looses a marker arrow at a target up to 8 tiles away that deals 28 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Sunlit Pasture
fusions.desc: Spreads a warm patch of grass 3 tiles around where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Chewed Over
fusions.desc: When your health fills, your next strike gains 20% critical hit chance. Once every 10 seconds.
